title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS, Two-Level Internal-Retry M5 Hybrid (eta_bad=1.0%, K=8) & ZERO-EA Det-m_boot, E[W(n)] < 2^113.364850291911 G1 units

claims.statement: For BLS12-381 G1 ECDLP with auxiliary powers (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp), on any supplied instance (n, A, T) with 1 <= n < r, A_i = [s^i mod r]P_0, and target T = A_1 = [s]P_0 in G_1 \ {infinity} (uniform 1 <= s < r; ignoring A_2..A_n with zero auxiliary-power accesses, constant work bound W(n) valid for all 1 <= n < r, scored at n = 2^20 = 1,048,576), under explicitly declared exploratory-v1 STNFS premises (H1, H2, H3, H-X, and Two-Level Internal-Retry H5-2lvl explicitly tolerating eta_bad=1.0% permanently dead/adversarial ideals at every level with K=8 conditionally-i.i.d. f-side q*p_rand_j internal retries in [2^16, 2^18) at min_mu0>=20, min_mu1>=20, p_good=0.35, deterministic post_cap_mult=4.0x pointwise post-sieve cap, inductive closure phi<=0.0120, and unconditional Boole ONLY over <=16 top-level ZERO-EA surv_b=1.0 deterministic-Lovasz m_boot=2592.0 boot children), the self-contained (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS algorithm transfers (P_0, T) to G_T via the public pairing e(., Q_0) and recovers the 64-hex scalar 1 <= s < r (verified via [s]P_0 = T) with cold-run success probability >= 0.39 and expected total classical work E[W(n)] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*10*(2^111.4009 + 2^66) < 2^113.364850291911 G1 target-group-operation units for all 1 <= n < r, in particular log2(W(2^20)) < 113.364850291911 (C = 2,000 baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A integer instructions; core rows in C_core = 20,000 = 10 G1 units, core 2^110.042922197024, unified aborting meter t_run = 2^123 core units giving deterministic pointwise cap < 2^126.3219282 G1 units).

experiments.purpose: Self-contained live verification of BLS12-381 (4,3) Q(zeta_15) algebra, Murphy-alpha, toy e2e DLP, Sigma-B exactness, 2D collection pool, 32-target 381-bit G_T ZERO-EA deterministic-Lovasz b_0 boot (n_scratch=1 + 32 certified bases, surv_b=1.0), 16-owner LA streaming placement & H3 zero-loss filtering ladder, genuine Q(zeta_15) H-X & gamma_0 lambda-cancellation, TOTAL-capped dsieve16 (internal+leaf, 32 genuine Q(zeta_15) roots), Two-Level Internal-Retry M5 Hybrid (eta_bad=1.0%, K=8, p_good=0.35, post_cap_mult=4.0x, eps_gate=0.20 +-1-only factor-12 Blichfeldt, exact O_H-coprimality unit test, 32 raw_M==0 above-cutoff ideals + 28 literal deg-(72,24) ideals), strict zero-omitted-children 240-ideal & 64-root diagnostics, and 80-digit Decimal ledger/gate.
